avis.texte: I am such a huge fan of I'm From's viral toner that I was excited to try their Rice Toner Pads. They are soaked in just the right amount of toner, are adjustable in size and very stretchy. Not only hydrating, they soothe my sensitive skin. They leave a nice glow after each use too! Loving the ingredients of these toner pads. Hydrating glycerin and olive fruit oil + niacinamide and the infamous Yeoju rice extracts offer a beautiful glow🌟 I would definitely recommend these toner pads 💛

avis.titre: It's so full of milky liquid and it's quite viscous like the
avis.texte: I am really enjoying this milky toner pads by I'm From. Always a fan of their Rice line as it really helps brighten and even out skintone. My go to line for brightening and smoothing. It's so full of milky liquid and it's quite viscous like the toner. It's basically a good on the go toner that you can travel with. As you swipe it across your face, it's like it's moisturizing your face and you put a very light layer of moisturizer on. I received this product for free but it's my honest opinion of this Rice Toner Pad. ㅤᵕ̈

avis.titre: My skin was visibly softened after letting the pads on for 2
avis.texte: A great product- a step up from the rice toner that lets your skin absorb even more moisture in. My skin was visibly softened after letting the pads on for 20min after 1st use so it will be amazing to use for whenever I'm in need of a super throughout hydration base for the rest of my skincare routine!

avis.titre: These pads are generously drenched in the essence..It's thin
avis.texte: After trying out the Viral I'm from Rice toner, I was super excited for the NEW Rice toner pads. These pads are generously drenched in the essence..It's thin, stretchy and adheres perfectly to the skin and has no fragrance or stickiness.I love that it comes with a tweezer to pull out the individual pads. I've been using these pads when my skin felt dull and dry.I leave it there for about 10-15mins for my skin to soak in all the essence and then take it off. My skin felt super hydrated & smooth.Totally recommend this🤎

avis.titre: The way they designed the lid and tweezer is a game changer
avis.texte: Always been a fan of the rice toner and wow this toner pad is definitely out of my expectation! The way they designed the lid and tweezer is a game changer - SOOOO convenient! The pads are stretchy so you can stretch it to the shape you need without having to cut it. I just love all the little details they've put into this. The essence itself is like the rice toner, milky and moisturizing, which gives my skin the much needed hydration and leaves a nice glow after. LOVEEEE IT :)

avis.titre: Each pad is generously soaked in this milky toner which cont
avis.texte: I've been a fan of the rice toner for a while, so I'm so happy that there is now a toner pad version, as they are so convenient and easy to use. The toner pads are soft and stretchy, so they are ideal for creating a toner pad mask on your face, or just as a quick way to apply your toner. Each pad is generously soaked in this milky toner which contains rice extract and niacinamide to brighten skin. After using, my skin feels much softer and looks glowy!

avis.titre: This milky toner contains hydrating and moisturizing glyceri
avis.texte: I'm From's cult-favorite Rice Toner is now available in pad form! This milky toner contains hydrating and moisturizing glycerin, olive oil, and betaine, as well as brightening rice and niacinamide. There are 60 pads per container, and all of them come well soaked in product. I don't detect any sort of fragrance. In addition to using these as traditional toner pads that you wipe over your face, their material is super stretchy, so you can use them as a targeted mini sheet masks. My skin is particularly dehydrated on my cheeks, so I like using them there for an extra boost.

avis.titre: so its perfect for toner masking and these are also DRENCHED
avis.texte: I always wanted a toner pad version of the rice toner cuz i love it so much and its finally here! I love the product from the pad all the way to the packaging. Ive used a LOT of toner pads on the market and truly love that the tweezers arent in the lid area cuz most times it would fall back. Now to the toner pad its STRETCHY! so its perfect for toner masking and these are also DRENCHED in toner but not too much that itll drip but enough that it doesnt dry out super fast. All in all LOVE!

avis.titre: Packaging is the same with their beet toner pad. It also has
avis.texte: Ever since I got obsessed with I'm From's rice toner, I've always wondered why they haven't released a toner pad yet 😭 It's been long overdue, but FINALLY, it's here, and it didn't disappoint! Packaging is the same with their beet toner pad. It also has its own tweezer, which is a plus. Compared to the beet toner pad, the pad has the same thickness, but this is softer and more stretchy. It has a very subtle milky scent that is almost unnoticeable and is generously soaked in milky essence. It feels so soft and nourishing! ✨️ This just came yesterday, so I wasn't able to test its brightening effect yet, but true to its claims, it is indeed soothing, hydrating, and nourishing. Can't wait to see more of its effects. 🫶

avis.titre: The toner has a milky formula and it's perfect for dry, dehy
avis.texte: So going into this, I had never tried the original rice toner from I'm from, so this is my first impression. The toner pads are very saturated and hold a lot of the toner and they also adhere wonderfully and stretch well on my skin. The toner has a milky formula and it's perfect for dry, dehydrated and aging skin. It's extremely nourishing and refreshing and my skin felt so smooth after using it. My only fear is that I'll go through them too fast because they feel great, especially with the hot weather we are having now. Definitely recommend these for plump and moist skin.

avis.titre: It comes in a convenient pad, easier to use and more radianc
avis.texte: I'm From Rice Toner is one of my favorite toners of all time and this has all the benefits of that toner and more. It comes in a convenient pad, easier to use and more radiance!

avis.titre: These pads are incredibly convenient for a quick cleanse as
avis.texte: As a long-time and faithful fan of the brand's rice line, I am super excited abo the launch of this new product . Now, they've introduced the Tiktok viral O.G Rice Toner effect in Toner Pads, and I couldn't be happier! These pads are incredibly convenient for a quick cleanse as soon as I wake up, without leaving my skin feeling dry. They provide an instant brightening effect, and my skin feels soft and luscious after use. The premium Yeoju rice extract naturally brightens and evens out my skin tone, and I'm pretty sure that with consistent & continuous use it'll definitely help in reducing my dark spots and hyperpigmentation for a much radiant complexion. I also love the very elastic material of the pad. It adjusts perfectly to different areas of my face, ensuring a seamless and effective application for my skincare routine. Whether I'm using it as a toner pack for deep nourishment or as a wipe-off toner to smooth and refine my skin texture, these pads deliver every time. For anyone looking for an easy, reliable way to maintain smooth and glowing skin, these Rice Toner Pads are a game-changer! Kudos again to Team I'm From! —and ofc TYSM to Team Wishtrend too!✨

avis.titre: Super moist with lot of essence.
avis.texte: If you like the toner you're going to love these! Super moist with lot of essence. Flexible pads that are easily to stretch to desired shape. Great to wipe to refresh and hydrate or use as DIY sheet mask! Gives plump skin and such a nice glow

avis.titre: They contain a nice amount of essence and are very moist.
avis.texte: This is a beautiful new addition to the rice line from I'm from! I love that I can not only use them as a toner to smooth and refine skin texture which leaves my skin smooth and hydrated but that I can also use them as a toner pack for deep nourishment and moisture. The pads are very stretchy and easy conform to the shape of my face. They stay nicely in place and deeply moisturize my skin. They contain a nice amount of essence and are very moist. My skin is prepared for the next steps in my skincare routine and feels hydrated, soft, smooth and has a beautiful glow.

avis.titre: The material has a stretchy feel which allows it to conform
avis.texte: I'm From's Rice Toner is one of my all time favorite products that I've used daily for years so I was SO excited to see it in this toner pad form! The pads are generously soaked in toner. The material has a stretchy feel which allows it to conform to the face nicely. Also adheres well for masking. I love that you can leave the pad on, or just swipe as a toner. The formula is both hydrating and nourishing which makes it perfect for my dry skin. This toner has helped brighten my skin and improve texture. It's a truly a must have and so excited to have it in pad form now! Highly recommend!!

avis.titre: The toner pad is a good size for masking and it is soaked wi
avis.texte: This is the second toner pad from I'm From that I've tried and I wasn't disappointed!! The toner pad is a good size for masking and it is soaked with product; just leave it on for about 10min and it's like using a sheet mask. For those who have been fans of the brand's popular rice toner, I think that this is a great toner pad version to consider purchasing! Another small detail I like is that the tweezers can be securely clipped onto the lid so it doesn't fall into the container. (Note: I was gifted this product by Wishtrend🩷)

avis.titre: If you're a big fan of the popular rice toner from I'm From
avis.texte: OMG!! WE FINALLY HAVE RICE TONER PADS FROM I'M FROM🫣 If you're a big fan of the popular rice toner from I'm From you'll love these toner pads! These toner pads are so moisturising and nourishing! The amount of essence is crazy?!🫣 They're so juicy! If you love sheet masks you can also use these pads as a mask! They're very stretchy and fits perfectly! If you love skincare with rice you should definitely get your hands on these toner pads!!

avis.titre: I absolutely adore the rice toner, so I could not wait to ge
avis.texte: I absolutely adore the rice toner, so I could not wait to get my hands on these toner pads. I love toner pads so much for their convenience and quick masking. I write this review while wearing three of the pads on my face. They are super stretchy and so they can cover larger areas. The pot has so much toner, so the pads are super juicy. The material is nice and soft too. I have had a peak at my skin underneath the pads and it looks and feels nicely hydrated with that freshly masked look. If you love the toner as much as I do, then these pads will be a welcome addition to your skincare routine!
